verdict.rationale: Reflect documents #tags on notes and lets you filter search by #tags, combined with other filters. Kindle sync also auto-tags imported notes as #book, so tag-based organization and retrieval is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows typed properties or structured metadata fields, so only the tag half of the story is delivered. missing for 10: typed/structured properties on notes, property-based querying or filtering, documentation of tag management depth (e.g. renaming, hierarchy), independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power-user, I can attach typed properties and tags to notes and use them consistently for organization and retrieval

citations.quote: You can filter notes by: Date created or updated, Daily Notes, Where they are backlinked to/from, #tags, Pinned notes
Reflect's search lets you apply as many filters as you'd like to find the notes you're looking for.
They will be imported into Reflect as individual notes, tagged as #book and the authors back-linked.
